sections.shortTitle: Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies Elections Amendment Order 1984
sections.section: ORDER - President's Order 8, Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Amendment) Order 1984
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 8 OF 1984
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
8 OF 1984
HOUSES OF
PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (ELECTIONS) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1984
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th October, 1984]
No. F. 17 (2)/84-Pub.-The
following Order, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information.
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order:
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the Houses of Parliament and
Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Amendment) Order 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article I. P.
(P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977.---In the Houses of Parliament and Provincial
Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P. (P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977], hereinafter
referred to as the said Order, in Article 1, clause (2) shall be omitted.
3. Amendment of Article 9, P.
(P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977.---In the said Order, in Article 9, for clause (1)
the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"(1) At an election to a
Muslim seat or a non-Muslim seat in the National Assembly or a Provincial
Assembly, only such persons shall be entitled to vote in a constituency as are
enrolled on the electoral roll prepared in accordance with law on the principle
of separate electorate for any electoral area in that constituency."
